method: Visually inspected every rendered page, 1–11, in contact sheets. Detailed full-page inspection of pages 6 and 7 (long scroll proof and bottom display) and page 9 (Chern-class displays). No visible clipping, overlaps, missing glyphs or unresolved ?? citations. Text, displays, bibliography and page numbers are legible. Final compiler log has no Overfull, Missing character, undefined or Warning matches.
scope: Presentation only; no mathematical review, repair or correctness certification.
